prompt: Create a vibrant high-energy anime illustration of a cheerful cat-eared idol girl in an extreme close-up, tilted dynamic composition, reaching toward the viewer with one hand while making a V-sign across one eye with the other. She has silvery white hair with pale lavender shadows, long flowing twin-tail-like hair and a thick side braid, large fluffy white cat ears with pink inner ears, one visible pointed elf-like ear, glossy blue-purple eyes, an open laughing mouth with tiny fang teeth, soft blush, and long blue-painted nails. Her outfit is a white and pale blue frilly idol/cat-girl costume with a small collar, gold bell at the throat, gold flower-shaped pendant with a pink jewel, ribbons, and lace. Add exactly 6 visible flower decorations: 3 small white blossoms along the braid, 1 pink flower hair clip near the right cat ear, 1 pale blue bow-flower near the left small mascot, and 1 gold flower brooch on the chest. Include exactly 3 small companion creatures: 2 tiny white fluffy cat-like mascots perched in her hair, one on the upper left and one on the right side, and 1 round blue fish-like mascot at the lower left. Include exactly 2 large surreal eyeball graphics in the background, one at upper left inside a hot-pink splatter and one at lower right, plus exactly 2 small fish graphics, one bright pink fish near the left hand and one blue fish at the lower left. Surround everything with bold pop-art shapes: hot pink hearts, magenta paint splashes, purple and cobalt abstract blobs, neon starbursts, sparkles, halftone dots, and glossy sticker-like accents. Use a saturated palette of hot pink, electric blue, violet, cyan, and pastel cream, crisp clean anime line art, luminous highlights, soft cel shading, intricate hair strands, playful chaotic kawaii energy, no text, no watermark. Canvas should be a horizontal 4:3 image, dense full-frame composition, character face centered and very close to the camera, with depth from the foreshortened reaching hand.

promptZh: 创作一张充满活力的高能动漫插画，主角为 一位开朗的猫耳偶像少女，采用极度特写和倾斜的动态构图。她一只手伸向观众，另一只手在眼睛前比出 V 字手势。她拥有 银白色头发，带有淡紫色阴影，长发飘逸如双马尾并留有一条粗侧辫，头顶一对毛茸茸的白色大猫耳，内耳为粉色，露出一只尖尖的精灵耳，拥有亮泽的蓝紫色双眸，张嘴大笑并露出小虎牙，脸颊微红，指甲涂着蓝色指甲油。她身穿白色与淡蓝色相间的荷叶边偶像/猫娘服装，配有小领子、喉间的金色铃铛、镶嵌粉色宝石的金色花朵吊坠、丝带和蕾丝。画面中需包含 6 个可见的花朵装饰：辫子上 3 朵小白花，右侧猫耳附近 1 个粉色花朵发夹，左侧小吉祥物附近 1 个淡蓝色蝴蝶结花朵，以及胸前 1 枚金色花朵胸针。包含 3 个小型伴随生物：2 个毛茸茸的白色小猫吉祥物栖息在她的头发上（左上方和右侧各一个），以及左下方 1 个圆滚滚的蓝色鱼形吉祥物。背景中包含 2 个超现实的大眼球图形，一个位于左上角的亮粉色喷溅图案中，另一个位于右下方；此外还有 2 个小鱼图形，一个亮粉色鱼在左手附近，另一个蓝色鱼在左下方。周围环绕着大胆的波普艺术形状：亮粉色爱心、洋红色颜料飞溅、紫色和钴蓝色抽象斑点、霓虹星爆、闪光、半调网点以及光泽感贴纸装饰。使用 亮粉色、电光蓝、紫罗兰色、青色和淡奶油色 的饱和色调，线条清晰利落，带有明亮的高光、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、精致的发丝细节，呈现出俏皮混乱的可爱能量，无文字，无水印。画布应为 4:3 横向比例，构图紧凑饱满，角色面部居中且极度靠近镜头，通过透视缩短的伸手动作营造出空间深度。
